name: SignalPatch | Daily CVE Review Intake (inactive starter)

nodes.name: Fetch NVD changes (24h)
nodes.notes: Uses the official NVD API. Add an API key via an n8n credential/header if rate limits require it.

nodes.name: Join NVD and KEV responses
nodes.notes: One response from each input is expected per execution.

nodes.name: Normalize and prioritize for review
nodes.notes: Deterministic ordering: CISA KEV matches first, then CVSS score. It does not assert local asset impact.

nodes.name: Deduplicate this batch
nodes.notes: Before production, add a durable n8n Data Table or database keyed by CVE ID and source modified date.

parameters.content:
## Import and validate before activation

This is an inactive intake starter, not an auto-broadcaster.

1. Import, then run manually. Verify both source responses and CVE/KEV matching.
2. Add a durable dedupe table keyed by CVE ID + modified timestamp.
3. Add a review surface (e.g. private Sheet/Data Table) with status defaulting to PENDING.
4. Build a separate approval-triggered workflow. Require an authorized reviewer to set APPROVED and preview the exact message.
5. Only then connect a Telegram Bot API credential and a private staging channel.
6. For production, least privilege: grant the bot only channel posting rights; store credentials in n8n credential storage.

Do not send directly from the schedule. Do not use AI to approve/publish. Keep the public dashboard labelled as demo until live data is wired and verified.
